messages:
Maya (marketing): Quick sync — landing copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Want clear, short hero + one-line subheads. Also plan benchmark callout and webinar CTA.
Ethan (product): +1. For benchmarks we can highlight cost/latency improvements but need infra numbers before any percent claims.
Lina (growth): Recommend avoiding hard % in the hero. Use 'Lower cost at scale' and surface exact numbers on the benchmark page.
Omar (design): I'll mock three-lane hero visual: Hosted | Dedicated | Private. Do we want separate CTAs per lane or a single unified CTA?
Jules (content): Separate CTAs — simpler routing. Hosted -> 'Start free', Dedicated -> 'Request capacity', Private -> 'Contact sales'.
Maya (marketing): Routing idea: Hosted = self-serve funnel, Dedicated = MQL form + drip, Private = AE handoff. Add hidden UTMs to split attribution.
Lina (growth): Webinar tie-in: 'Serving LLMs at Scale' on May 12. Use registration to seed Dedicated/Private pipeline.
Jules (content): Two headline candidates: A) 'High-performance LLM inference. Anywhere you run it.' B) 'Predictable latency. Predictable cost.'
Ethan (product): A is product-first, B is buyer-first. Use A on product pages, B on enterprise flows and ads.
Omar (design): Figma mockups uploaded: https://fig.ma/redwood/tri-mode-hero-v2 (private). Will try both one-line and two-line hero.
Maya (marketing): Copy scrub suggestion: short hero line + subhead that lists 3 bullets (one per mode). Example subheads we can iterate on.
Jules (content): Draft microcopy for bullets:
Hosted — Hosted API: fastest time-to-value, public models + curated profiles
Dedicated — Reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput & SLAs
Private — VPC or on-prem deployments, compliance & key management
Ethan (product): Small note: avoid naming specific model families in marketing unless we've published benchmarks. Use 'verified open-model profiles' instead.
Maya (marketing): Benchmarks placement: small ribbon in hero linking to dedicated benchmark page. Keep ribbon subtle.
Lina (growth): For inbound routing rules: Hosted -> checkout / self-serve signup; Dedicated -> short lead form (field: capacity_commit); Private -> AE handshake + security questionnaire link.
Jules (content): Also propose short social launch post for the webinar: 2 lines + CTA. Will draft variants after hero is settled.
Omar (design): I'll provide two layout variants: with badge and without. A/B test on roster.
Maya (marketing): Action items: Jules — hero + three subheads + CTAs draft by EOD Wed; Omar — Figma variants; Lina — webinar landing + routing rules; Ethan — confirm benchmark phrasing with infra; I'll coordinate UTMs and experiment plan.
deploy-bot: New design file pushed: 1757771250 - marketing/tri-mode-hero-v2.fig
Lina (growth): Noted. I'll wire the registration to the Dedicated/Private segments and add analytics flags.
Jules (content): Draft uploaded to Drive: /drive/marketing/copy/drafts/1757771234-copy-surgeon-draft.md
Maya (marketing): One quick Q: objection to a tiny benchmark badge in hero? Might add credibility if done carefully.
Ethan (product): Fine as a subtle ribbon linking to method page. No absolute claims in the ribbon.
Omar (design): Will test spacing impact. Two variants as noted.
Maya (marketing): OK — I'll run this as a copy experiment next week once drafts are in. :rocket:
Jules (content): I'll also stub the webinar email sequence and a short benchmark narrative for the dedicated page (2–3 bullets + CTA).
Lina (growth): I'll ensure the webinar registrants are routed into the Dedicated lead flow and tag by interest.
Maya (marketing): Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the A/B mock tests and copy pass. :thumbsup:
